file_stem: RWB TE 005 Rule table test harness
title: Rule table test harness
goal: Test every rule row against its own test case on load and in every build, just like code
why: Retired by D-RCV-36 T8 (rules move to Drools XLS packages); the new home is RWB-E1-073. Shown here so readers see what the story covered.
triggers: Gradle task ruleTests per rule ID
ace_note: No ACE read. Each test builds a synthetic case file from facts.

writes.note: one test case per rule row

reads.note: route set, from state, event, condition, owner

functions.name: RuleTableHarnessImpl
functions.does: runs each test via the evaluator

rules: BR1: one test case per rule row
BR2: pass = exactly one hit, the named row, and expected values
BR3: any failure -> FAILED; it cannot be approved
risks: Rule row without a test -> FAILED (MSG-P3-014)
Two rows hit -> fail naming both (MSG-P3-014)
